headings.title: Construction indemnification for another's negligence void
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that indemnification or hold-harmless agreements in construction contracts protecting another from their own negligence are void.

headings.title: Exceptions to construction indemnity prohibition
headings.reviewNote: Covers nine statutory exceptions including party's own negligence, insurance requirements, intergovernmental agreements, and railroad contracts.

headings.title: Scope of construction work defined
headings.reviewNote: Covers broad definition of construction work including alterations, maintenance, design, engineering, surveying, and management services.

headings.title: Applicability to contracts entered after August 28, 1999
headings.reviewNote: Covers prospective applicability restriction to contracts or agreements entered into after August 28, 1999.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections against archived text: voiding of construction indemnity agreements for another's negligence or wrongdoing, nine statutory exceptions, definition of construction work, and post-August 28, 1999 applicability.

headings.title: Nonassignability and legal process exemption of pension plan benefits
headings.reviewNote: Covers prohibition on transfer or assignment of plan benefits and exemption from execution, garnishment, or legal process, subject to support orders.

headings.title: Prohibition on evasive schemes and joint account devices
headings.reviewNote: Covers prohibition against pension assignees using joint accounts, powers of attorney, or other devices to evade anti-assignment rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: nonassignability and legal-process exemption of plan benefits (with statutory division and support-order exceptions) and prohibition on evasive schemes or joint-account devices.

headings.title: Void contracts and mandatory restitution of collected pension sums
headings.reviewNote: Covers invalidation of contracts violating section 434.301 and requirement that pension assignees return collected sums to recipients or heirs.

headings.title: Private right of action to enforce pension restitution
headings.reviewNote: Covers authorization for benefit recipients, guardians, conservators, or heirs to bring civil actions to enforce restitution.

headings.title: Five-year statute of limitations for pension restitution claims
headings.reviewNote: Covers five-year limitation period for bringing restitution actions running from the date of the unlawful act or practice.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text: voidness and mandatory restitution for section 434.301 violations, private right of action, and 5-year statute of limitations.

headings.title: Attorney general injunctive enforcement without bond
headings.reviewNote: Covers authority of the attorney general to bring circuit court actions for temporary or permanent injunctions without bond.

headings.title: Attorney general restitution actions and investigative powers
headings.reviewNote: Covers attorney general recovery of restitution on behalf of recipients and exercise of chapter 407 investigative and enforcement powers.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: permissive attorney general injunctive actions without bond and restitution, investigative, enforcement, and cost-recovery powers under chapter 407.
